name: Revoty – Sales Booster for WooCommerce
author: Çağdaş Dağ

sections.description:
Revoty is a powerful sales booster for WooCommerce that helps you increase conversions and build customer trust through authentic photo reviews. Let your customers showcase real product experiences with photos, creating social proof that drives sales.

Why Photo Reviews Matter

  • 85% of consumers trust online reviews as much as personal recommendations
  • Visual reviews increase conversion rates by up to 30%
  • Customer photos are 5x more trusted than brand photos
  • Products with photo reviews sell 2x more than those without

📸 Photo Reviews Features

Upload & Display
* ✅ Let customers upload multiple photos with their product reviews
* ✅ Beautiful, responsive photo gallery on product pages
* ✅ Automatic image optimization and thumbnail generation
* ✅ Support for common image formats (JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP)
* ✅ Configurable file size limits (up to 10MB per photo)
* ✅ Set maximum number of photos per review (1-10 photos)

Stunning Gallery Display
* ✅ Attractive grid layout showcasing customer photos at the top of reviews
* ✅ Customizable gallery title (e.g., “Customer Photos”, “Real Photos from Buyers”)
* ✅ Control how many photos appear in the gallery (4-24 photos)
* ✅ Remaining photos shown within individual reviews
* ✅ Mobile-optimized responsive design
* ✅ Fast loading with lazy-load support

Professional Lightbox
* ✅ Click any photo to view in full-size lightbox
* ✅ Smooth navigation between photos with prev/next arrows
* ✅ Keyboard support (arrow keys, ESC to close)
* ✅ Display reviewer information alongside photos:
– Reviewer name
– Star rating
– Review comment excerpt
* ✅ Fully customizable lightbox info display
* ✅ Touch-friendly on mobile devices

Admin Control Panel
* ✅ Modern, intuitive settings interface built with React
* ✅ Real-time settings preview
* ✅ Enable/disable photo uploads globally
* ✅ Make photos optional or required for reviews
* ✅ Photo moderation – approve photos before public display
* ✅ Choose display order (newest/oldest first)
* ✅ Granular control over lightbox information display

Moderation & Quality Control
* ✅ Optional photo moderation workflow
* ✅ Review photos before they go live
* ✅ Prevent inappropriate content
* ✅ Maintain brand quality standards
* ✅ All photos stored in WordPress media library for easy management

Developer Friendly
* ✅ Clean, modular code architecture
* ✅ WordPress coding standards compliant
* ✅ Translation ready with proper i18n
* ✅ Hooks and filters for customization
* ✅ Well-documented codebase

🚀 Coming Soon

  • Free Shipping Progress Bar – Show customers how much more to spend for free shipping
  • FOMO Notifications – Display recent purchases and stock alerts
  • Social Proof Widgets – Showcase review counts and ratings
  • Advanced Analytics – Track photo review performance
  • And much more…

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Modern web browser with JavaScript enabled

Perfect For

  • Online stores wanting to increase trust and conversions
  • Brands looking to showcase authentic customer experiences
  • WooCommerce shops with visual products (fashion, home decor, etc.)
  • Stores wanting to stand out from competitors
  • Businesses focused on building social proof

Privacy & Data Handling

Revoty respects your privacy and your customers’ privacy:

  • No External Services: All data stays on your WordPress installation
  • No Tracking: We don’t track your usage or collect analytics
  • Media Library Storage: Customer photos are stored in your WordPress media library
  • Standard WordPress Data: Only uses standard WordPress/WooCommerce user data
  • GDPR Friendly: Compatible with GDPR requirements when used with WooCommerce’s GDPR tools
  • No Cookies: The plugin doesn’t set any cookies

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Revoty”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  5. Go to Revoty > Dashboard to get started

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Click “Activate Plugin”
  6. Go to Revoty > Dashboard to configure

Configuration

  1. Navigate to Revoty > Dashboard in your WordPress admin
  2. The Photo Reviews module is enabled by default
  3. Click on Photo Reviews in the sidebar to access settings
  4. Configure your preferences:
    • Enable/disable photo uploads
    • Set maximum photos per review (1-10)
    • Set maximum file size (1-10 MB)
    • Make photos optional or required
    • Enable moderation if desired
    • Customize gallery appearance
    • Configure lightbox display options
  5. Click “Save Changes”
  6. Visit any WooCommerce product page to see photo reviews in action!
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, Revoty is built specifically for WooCommerce and requires WooCommerce 7.0 or higher to be installed and activated.

Can I limit the number of photos per review?

Absolutely! You can set the maximum number of photos (1-10) that customers can upload with each review in the Photo Reviews settings panel.

What image formats are supported?

The plugin supports common image formats including JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF, and WebP. You can also set maximum file size limits (up to 10MB per photo).

Are the photos moderated before they appear?

You have full control! You can enable the moderation option, which requires admin approval before photos are displayed publicly. Or disable it to show photos immediately after submission.

Where are the photos stored?

All uploaded photos are stored in your WordPress media library, making them easy to manage, edit, or delete using the standard WordPress media interface.

Is the plugin mobile responsive?

Yes! The photo upload interface, gallery, and lightbox are all fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices, tablets, and desktops.

Can I customize the gallery appearance?

Yes! You can customize:
– Gallery title text
– Number of photos displayed in the gallery (4-24)
– Display order (newest or oldest first)
– Lightbox information display (show/hide reviewer name, rating, comment)

Will this slow down my site?

No! The plugin is optimized for performance with:
– Lazy loading for images
– Efficient database queries
– Minified CSS and JavaScript
– Only loads assets when needed

Can customers edit or delete their photos?

Photos are tied to the review comment. Customers can edit their review through WooCommerce’s standard review editing functionality if enabled on your site.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes! Revoty integrates seamlessly with WooCommerce’s standard review system, making it compatible with any properly coded WooCommerce theme.

How do I disable photo uploads temporarily?

Simply go to Revoty > Photo Reviews and toggle off the “Enable Photo Reviews” switch. This will hide the upload interface while preserving all existing photos.

Does it support multisite?

Yes, Revoty is compatible with WordPress multisite installations. Each site can have its own independent configuration.
